style: high-quality 2D fighting game sprite art in a late-1990s arcade fighting game look: hand-painted pixel-art feel, bold dark outlines, cel shading with vivid saturated colors and crisp highlights, dynamic martial-arts anatomy
rules: The whole background must be ONE flat solid magenta color #FF00FF (pure chroma key). The character must NOT contain any magenta or pink.
No shadows, no ground line, no floor, no grid lines, no borders, no text, no numbers, no watermark.

Every cell contains exactly ONE complete full-body character (head to toes fully visible), centered in its own cell with at least 12% empty margin on every side; nothing may touch the cell edges and neighbouring cells must never overlap.
The character is drawn at the SAME scale in every cell (same head size, same body proportions), same outfit and same colors in every cell.

The character ALWAYS faces RIGHT (face and chest toward the right edge of the image) in every cell. Never mirror or flip the character. Orthodox stance: left foot and left fist forward (toward the right); light/quick punches use the FRONT fist, heavy punches use the REAR fist.
Poses must follow the frame list exactly, in reading order (left to right, top row first), with clear and smooth progression between neighbouring frames.
stanceNote: Frame 1 is ALWAYS the neutral fighting stance (same as the character reference image): side-on, knees bent, both fists raised to guard the chin. It is used as a size reference.

stages.market: A wide side-view 2D fighting game stage background: a rainy East Asian neon night market street at night, rows of food stalls with glowing lanterns and neon signs (abstract shapes, NO readable text), a crowd of silhouetted spectators behind a low railing in the middle distance, wet asphalt street in the foreground reflecting neon colors. The ground plane occupies the bottom 22% of the image and is flat and empty (no characters, no objects) so fighters can stand on it. Painted late-1990s arcade fighting game background art, rich detail, cinematic lighting.
stages.beach: A wide side-view 2D fighting game stage background: a seaside stone plaza in Brazil at sunset, colorful houses on green hills, palm trees, the ocean glittering on the horizon, a circle of silhouetted spectators and musicians with drums and berimbau standing on the left and right sides in the middle distance. The ground plane (worn stone tiles) occupies the bottom 22% of the image and is flat and empty in the center so fighters can stand on it. NO readable text. Painted late-1990s arcade fighting game background art, rich detail, warm cinematic lighting.
